title: StageShowOutput
description: Output of `gentry stage show --json`: the current stage of the task from the snapshot of its flow.

task.description: Identifier of the task, such as SHOP-1.

node.description: Node of the scenario the task is at.

round.description: Number of the pass of the node in the task, from 1.

executor.description: Who does the stage: orchestrator, operator or a subagent.

exit.description: What the stage must end with.

instruction.description: Instruction of the stage in markdown.

parts.description: Parts the stage includes, in the order of include.

text.description: Text of the part in markdown.

transitions.description: Transitions from the node in the order of the scenario.

to.description: The node of the transition, or finish for the end of the scenario.

stage.description: Stage of that node; absent for finish.

title.description: Title of that stage; absent for finish.

if.description: Condition of the transition; absent for one without.

max_returns.description: Limit of returns by the transition; only for a return.

returns.description: Returns made by the transition, counted anew after a return by an outer loop; only for a return.
